selected_evidence.requirement: Healthy baseline before change (pre-existing sysctl state and boot identity)
selected_evidence.summary: Captured boot_id 1e0cb179-d384-41f8-aa25-9390b31eec45 and pre-change sysctl values (accept_redirects=1, accept_source_route default=1) before any modification

selected_evidence.requirement: Persistently disable ICMP redirect acceptance and source-routed packet acceptance for IPv4
selected_evidence.summary: Created /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf with accept_redirects=0, secure_redirects=0, accept_source_route=0 for all/default, applied via sysctl --system, and confirmed runtime values are 0

selected_evidence.requirement: Node restart acknowledgement returned before disconnection
selected_evidence.summary: Reboot scheduled in background (ack returned), and boot_id still matched pre-restart value on the immediate next poll, proving the command didn't hang and reboot was deferred as intended

selected_evidence.requirement: Direct proof node actually restarted (changed boot identity, not just elapsed time)
selected_evidence.summary: Connection timed out mid-reboot (node unreachable), then command execution resumed with a new boot_id (1fb98aa9-ea0c-495d-accf-b9f92d41bd72), distinct from the baseline 1e0cb179-...

After restart, /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf still present and runtime sysctl values for accept_redirects, secure_redirects, and accept_source_route (all/default) confirmed as 0, proving persistence across reboot

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== boot id baseline =="
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
uptime -s || true
echo "== current sysctl values (pre-change) =="
sysctl net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route 2>&1 || true

net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route = 1

commands.command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
echo "== writing persistent sysctl config =="
sudo -n tee /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf > /dev/null <<'EOF'
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.all.secure_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.secure_redirects = 0
net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route = 0
net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route = 0
EOF
cat /etc/sysctl.d/60-network-hardening.conf

echo "== applying =="
sudo -n sysctl --system

echo "== verify runtime values =="
sysctl net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_redirects net.ipv4.conf.all.secure_redirects net.ipv4.conf.default.secure_redirects net.ipv4.conf.all.accept_source_route net.ipv4.conf.default.accept_source_route
